title: Replicating CoT Monitorability Study on Gemma-3-4B: Does Scale Within a Family Matter?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: understanding intra-family scaling of monitorability could help predict monitoring requirements. However, the generalizability beyond Gemma-3 is uncertain and the safety impact is indirect (planning/prediction rather than defense).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Gemma-3-4B and 9B are publicly available and run on medium compute. MALT provides standardized data. The 27B model may exceed medium compute, but 4B vs. 9B comparison is feasible. Straightforward experimental design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two to three models of the same family, one benchmark, one metric. Clear deliverable: AUROC comparison across scales. If limited to 4B and 9B, very tight and achievable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
